profileSnapshot.description: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches - when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions.

prompt:

目标：完整盘点该项目"发现的缺陷"。重点：

2. 全树搜索其他缺陷/事故/审计记录：grep 关键词 缺陷、事故、坑、审计、修复、作废、复盘、PROVEN、FAIL，特别关注 `本体库-作废-20260926-R000R001`（今天作废的目录，找出作废原因）、`试车门槛-预注册-v2.md` 与 v1 的差异（为何升版）、`BUILD-STATE.md`、`工作区/` 下的日志与报告。

A. 项目概况 5 行以内
B. 缺陷逐条清单（每条：出处文件:行、一句话现象、根因、状态）——这是重点，要全，不要省略
C. 作废目录原因说明
D. 与 CBB 已知问题的同类/新形态分类
